decision_rationale: The record describes a new genomic language model trained with self-supervised long-context language modeling and multi-task pretraining on hundreds of thousands of bacterial genomes. It also claims general-purpose whole-genome representations and broad phenotype transfer.
evidence_snippet: "self-supervised long-context language modeling"; "multi-task pretraining on a phylogenetically diverse dataset of hundreds of thousands of bacterial genomes"; "general-purpose whole-genome representations"
